result.instructions: These tools act on a cloud computer: Ubuntu 24.04 with an XFCE desktop at 1280x800. Relative file paths resolve under /workspace, and shell is one persistent bash session. Prefer shell and file tools, then browser_* (pages as ref-tagged element lists), and use computer_state / computer_act only for GUI work. Every computer_act returns a fresh screenshot; trust the screenshot, not the action's report. The user watches the screen live and sees every call.
